named_method: Generalized least squares / covariance-weighted Local Distance Network
definition_used: Linear distance-ladder equations y = A beta + epsilon with diagonal observational covariance W=diag(1/sigma^2); beta includes host distance moduli, SN Ia absolute magnitude, and log10(H0).

non_negotiable_steps.step: Represent anchor/primary distance, calibrator, and Hubble-flow observations in one design matrix
Weight measurements by stated uncertainties including anchor, method-anchor, photometric, and peculiar-velocity terms
Solve covariance-weighted normal equations and propagate covariance to H0
Run named variants by indicators/anchors/hosts and external comparison
Full non-diagonal systematic covariance across surveys and all prompt-listed indicators
non_negotiable_steps.reason: Minimal dataset does not contain off-diagonal covariance matrices or Miras/JAGB/SNe II/FP/TF rows.

key_assumptions: Host primary-distance rows are interpreted as calibrated distance moduli with additional anchor and method-anchor zero-point uncertainty added in quadrature.
Hubble flow uses cz/H0 luminosity-distance approximation because minimal data do not include cosmographic corrections.
SBF branch is analyzed only as a proxy diagnostic because SBF calibrators lack direct primary-distance rows.
